title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and artists from over 160 eligible countries
deadline: Varies by country (typically April - October annually)
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, monthly stipend, health insurance, airfare)
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent academic credential
description: Enables graduate students, young professionals, and artists from abroad to study and conduct research in the United States at universities or other academic institutions.

title: Google Software Engineering Internship 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or related technical field
qualification: Experience in data structures, algorithms, and coding in C++, Java, Python, or Go
description: Offers students the opportunity to work on real-world engineering challenges, contribute to large-scale products, and receive mentorship from Google engineers.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Entry-level web developers globally with strong JavaScript and web technology fundamentals
qualification: Bachelor's degree in CS or equivalent practical experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks
description: Build, test, and maintain accessibility-focused, high-performance web user interfaces supporting Wikipedia and free knowledge projects worldwide.

title: Rhodes Scholarship
eligibility: Outstanding young leaders aged 18–24 from eligible global constituencies
salary: Fully Funded (Full tuition, living stipend, travel expenses)
qualification: Completed undergraduate degree with exceptional academic achievement and leadership potential
description: Fully funded postgraduate award allowing exceptional young people from around the world to study at the University of Oxford.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of relevant experience
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field
description: Participate in a rotational product management program designing next-generation cloud applications, defining product vision, and working with cross-functional engineering teams.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 18+ enrolled in accredited high schools or higher education institutions globally
salary: $100,000 USD Grand Prize + Azure credits + Mentorship
qualification: Open to all student innovators, developers, and entrepreneurs
description: Microsoft's premier global technology competition for students encouraging teams to create innovative solutions addressing global issues using Microsoft AI and cloud technology.
